data.name: Muthusamy
data.gender_notes: Muthusamy is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Muthusamy is derived from the Tamil language. This name is composed of two words: ‘Muthu’ meaning ‘God’ and ‘Samy’ meaning ‘Wealth’. In Hindu mythology, Muthusamy is often associated with the god of wealth, Kubera. The name Muthusamy carries the meaning “God of Wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Tamil tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Muthusamy usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes abundance, prosperity, and material wealth.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muthusamy total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
